source_tokens.text: "Faith Friday (2025-09-19, https://hitchhikertothefuture.substack.com/p/faith-friday) is the origin of the prediction methodology: make specific predictions about outcomes and use whether they are right as feedback on whether one is on the right track; the more one can predict, the better one knows one is doing. It is also the origin of the shorting-complexity thesis and the stated definition of Time Violence"

source_tokens.text: "CLAIM-004 (origin: Faith Friday 'shorting complexity', 2025-09-19; informed by AcadeResearch 2026 cohort): as enterprises add AI, complexity and inefficiency will rise before they fall - AI-adopter overhead ratios (G&A plus R&D as percent of revenue) will expand in the investment phase before contracting. Falsifier: AI-adopter overhead ratios contract immediately at scale, or no AI-adopting enterprise shows an investment-phase overhead step-up"

source_tokens.text: "CLAIM-005 (origin: Faith Friday prediction methodology, 2025-09-19; 9/22/25 option-trade record): Leo's public directional predictions about market outcomes will be correct more than 50% of the time over a declared sample, establishing a real (not memetic) track record. The 87% figure was memetic, not calculated. Falsifier: correctness at 50% or less over the declared sample. Initial sample: UNH Dec25 400p (direction right, already ITM, weak hit), INTU Apr26 400p (big hit), ACN Mar26 200p (near-exact hit), ADP Jan26 200p (direction right, timing wrong, partial), VIX Dec25 30c (missed), TSLA Dec26 500c (unresolved)"
